scripture.verse: For without the law sin was dead. For I was alive without the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.

sermons.title: Sermon 3476 | Holy Song From Happy Saints

scripture.verse: Now will I sing to my Well-Beloved a song of my Beloved.
This is the house of the Lord God, and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.
And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned. But now they desire a better country, that is an heavenly country.
For by Grace are you saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God.
While the King sits at His table, my spikenard sends forth its fragrance.

Therefore, that disciple whom Jesus loved said unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, heput on his outer garment (for he was naked), and plunged into the sea. But the other disciples came in the little boat; for they were not far from land (about two hundred cubits), dragging the net with fishes.
I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O Lord: I will keep Your statutes. I cried unto You; save me, and I shall keep Your testimonies.
For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.
